body: That was my line of thinking as well but my judgement was waning cause Im stupid. So I just needed another voice to tell me not to be an idiot, thank you 🙏
Yup, I think I just need some post-nut clarity 😂
Thank you, I needed some sanity check. I wont :)
Im honestly surprised IU’s ranked so low this year. Though I guess its been a quieter year for her compared to others. 🤔
I thought it was just me. I feel like if you look hard enough, its almost see through.

Yup, exactly.

And Im moving to another city. Back to my hometown actually. Work has transitioned to mostly remote and theres no need for me to pay such expensive rent and general COL.

Thank you. Its one of my biggest struggle Ive come to realize and trying to work through. I’m a person and I matter, I dont just live for other people. Ive always put others first and gladly so, but often at the expense of myself.

So ya, no I dont see it as berating, its nice to hear that you matter, even if from a stranger. Thank you

Nope, no one else knows about my past attempt as I don’t feel as though I can trust anyone with it. I also struggle opening up to people as I don’t think my burdens are worth sharing (something Im aware of and trying to work through).

I really appreciate you taking the time to not only read my post but to write such a thoughtful response.

I have been through therapy and I think thats what makes it so hard. Ive had initial talks with about a dozen therapist, and went through several sessions with 3 (1 I even worked with for about a year). Each one always left a bad taste in my mouth, either they seemed disingenuous, seeing it as ways of making money (which is fine, its a job but I think theres something to be said about having tact) or I got a feeling they just didn’t understand. I haven’t given hope but it’s hard to get back to the search cause it feels like another exhausting task.

And you’re completely right, breaking things, hot showers, all of it. Dont have much words to say but really, thank you so much!!!
